Weather × time-of-day × lap position

66 frames, TLX on SwiftShader (no real GPU), 1280×720 captured, shown at 640 px; committed copies are 900 px JPEGs under artifacts/shots/tracks/monaco/. Lap positions: 0 · 17 · 33 · 50 · 67 · 83 % of the lap.

Dry · day · orbit

Baseline. Blocky pastel city, low-poly hills; sea only visible from f33. Orbit at f00/f50 sits on tarmac/against the tunnel overburden slab, so little scenery shows.

Dry · day · driver eye

Driver-eye baseline. Green racing-line chevrons are the assist overlay, not scenery. Tunnel (f50) reads well: arched vault, lamps, coloured livery strips.

Wet · day

Wet sheen on road and terrain; grass patches mirror trees and buildings like a pond (renderer wet pass, not circuit code). Sky stays dark blue-grey.

Rain · day

Day rain now reads as daylight grey deck (PR #1979 applied). Rain streaks faint at this scale; terrain reflections strong.

Overcast · day

Near-identical to dry: sky stays saturated blue, little visible cloud. Overcast response is weak with an explicit --tod day.

Fog · day

Ground haze whitens mid-distance buildings but the sky remains clear deep blue: fog and sky disagree.

Storm · day

Almost indistinguishable from rain; no stronger darkening, lightning or heavier streaks visible in a still.

Dry · dusk

Warm low sun and lamp pools work. Distant fill towers already read overbright/white.

Dry · night

Sky black, street lamps cast warm pools (good). Distant white fill/backdrop blocks stay almost day-bright and most facade windows are dark.

Rain · dusk

Wet dusk: wet road reflects lamps and chevrons; terrain acts as a mirror.

Rain · night

Wet night: lamp reflections good; far white towers still overbright; terrain mirror-like.

Ranked defects and suggested fixes (not applied)

1. High — Overcast and fog leave the day sky saturated blue (frames 25-36)
Weather frames at --tod day: overcast ≈ dry; fog whitens the ground only. Probable mechanism (not isolated by A/B): js/lighting/atmosphere.js:444-461 — the overcast/fog branches flatten the sky horizon only when raceTimeOfDay === "default" (:458), while the wet/rain branch got _dayWetGreyDeck(...) at :442 (PR #1979). Explicit day gets no grey deck for overcast/fog.
Suggested fix: Apply the same _dayWetGreyDeck blend (lower weight) in the overcast and fog branches, or drop the "default" guard for daytime. Engine, shared by every circuit.
atmosphere.js:442-461
2. High — Night: far fill towers and backdrops stay near day-white; facade windows mostly dark (frames 49-66, also 43-48 dusk)
White boxes from the city fill (FILL palette, MAT.CONCRETE, scenery/monaco.js:1680-1700) and tower()/backdrop() blocks (:257-270, :1220-1236) are lit like day; only a thin WINLIT band per tower is emissive. Reads as glowing paper blocks against a black sky.
Suggested fix: Darken far-field fill at night (per-tod albedo multiplier in the engine's far-prop pass), and give fill blocks a sparse emissive window pattern instead of a uniform pale body. Circuit-side: tint FILL by tod, or cull fill > 600 m at night.
scenery/monaco.js:1680-1700, 257-270
3. Medium — Daytime storm indistinguishable from rain (37-42 vs 19-24)
Storm shares the rain branch (wxWet/wxRain, atmosphere.js:355-445); no extra darkening, streak density or lightning evident in stills.
Suggested fix: Give storm its own multipliers (sun mute 0.35, cloud 0.96, rain density ×1.6) or document that they are one state. Not verified in motion (stills only).
atmosphere.js:355-445
4. Medium — Wet/rain terrain behaves as a mirror: trees and buildings reflected in grass like a pond (13-24, 53-66)
Wet material pass applies the road-style specular reflection to the grass terrain material. Cause is in the renderer wet-surface response; not located to a line this survey (read-only, no A/B).
Suggested fix: Cap reflectivity on terrain/foliage materials in wet; keep it on tarmac and kerbs. Needs a renderer owner (skill renderer-debug).
unlocated (render wet pass)
5. Medium — Backdrop mountains are faceted green/tan pyramids
api.mountain(...) calls place 9 low-poly hills (seg 14, rough 0.26) at 800-3300 m; shapes read as generic low-poly cones, not the limestone Tête de Chien / Mont Agel cliffs of the brief.
Suggested fix: Raise seg and rough, bias the rock colour grey-cream with sparse vegetation and add a steep cliff face on the 315° bearing.
scenery/monaco.js:1605-1620
6. Medium — Many palms/props are guard-dropped; marina sparser than authored
verify-track: suppressed place=5 building=5 palm=71 cypress=1 stonePine=3. modelDiagnostics: only 1 of 4 pontoons and 4 of 6 far sailboats emitted (afloat() guard) and 5 wall + 3 palm superseded by the pit complex. Frames show few palms (the brief's "palm-lined" read is weak).
Suggested fix: List which palm loops (:1184-1196, generic furniture) lose the most and relocate their fracs; accept pontoon cull or carve basin (comment at :866-868).
scenery/monaco.js:1184-1196, 1449-1470
7. Low — Sainte Dévote modelGroup declared box is 5.4 m lower than its campanile
modelDiagnostics.escaped: overUp 5.37, overRight 1.0. Declared size [11.2,14.5,13.5] vs emitted cross at ~18.7 m. Risk: footprint/cull tests use the smaller box. Also Café 0.2, Tabac 1.3, Rascasse 0.6 m.
Suggested fix: Enlarge `size` heights to the emitted extent (≈20 m) for monaco-sainte-devote; widen Tabac/Rascasse by ≥1.3 m.
scenery/monaco.js:197-199, 988-990, 1094-1096
8. Low — Casino Square fountain is raw geometry (not a required modelGroup); preflight would drop it silently
Documented in-file (:469-481): wrapped, preflight rejects it as "superseded by the pit complex" although the nearest pit-keep node is 308 m away — an engine question. Fountain is absent from modelDiagnostics.emitted by design; not seen in any frame (orbit f17/f33 views do not frame the plaza).
Suggested fix: Investigate js/track pit keep-out for node 126; then wrap as required modelGroup.
scenery/monaco.js:464-490
9. Low — Six coordinate idioms (K, KR, KOLD, KRACE, KRAW, SRACE) in one file invite raw-frac mistakes
The 2026-10-05 re-key fixed 9 landmarks; the lamp loops, harbour water stations (`harbourStations` :1341 commented "racing fractions" but passed to K(), a source-frame wrapper), marina rows and cityFront rows still use K(); only KOLD is an empirical -24 node fudge (:36-47).
Suggested fix: Migrate remaining K(...) sites to KRACE and delete KOLD once the tunnel/portal fracs are re-measured; keep `scratch/monaco-measure.cjs`-style verification in tests.
scenery/monaco.js:36-80, 1341
10. Low — Orbit framing at f00 and f50 is uninformative (tool, not circuit)
camera.clear moved=false: the orbit sits on tarmac (f00) or looks at the tunnel overburden slab (f50). 12 of 66 frames therefore show road/slab only.
Suggested fix: Use trackside/eye at these stations for future surveys.
tools/shot (camera)

Source claims vs measurement

Measured here (Node VM + browser): built length, corner radii/sweeps, elevation extremes, hw range, audit counts, emitted geometry, every frame observation. Source claims not independently verified (no web fetch this session): real lap 3.337 km, 78 laps, 19 turns, ~42-45 m elevation range, corner names, OSM trace origin (bacinger/f1-circuits, ODbL, per the def comment) and the SRTM figure. Defect mechanisms #1, #3 are probable readings of the code, not A/B-confirmed.

Not captured / uncertain

  • Cut from the plan: trackside views, dawn, fog/overcast/storm at dusk or night, and eye views for weather (66 frames, ~35 s each). Eye was captured only for dry day.
  • Orbit at f00 and f50 is obstructed (see defect 10); Casino Square plaza, harbour yachts and pool deck were never framed head-on, so the fountain, yacht berths and pool geometry are unverified visually.
  • Stills cannot show rain streak motion, lightning, tunnel shimmer or z-fighting; coplanar audit is the only evidence (0 spots).
  • SwiftShader, not a player GPU: lighting/reflection behaviour on real GPUs is unconfirmed.
  • Gallery parser (survey-gallery-lib WEATHER_TAIL) does not know storm, so storm frames list with tod "unknown" — see build result in the hand-off.
